exposure: Examined group (infants with severe retinopathy of prematurity (ROP) treated by diode laser or anti-VEGF intravitreal injection)
Positive bacterial cultures from the throat, anus, ear, bronchi, and blood
outcome: Severe ROP requiring diode laser or anti-VEGF treatment
Levels of white blood cells (WBC), C-reactive protein (CRP), lymphocytes (LYM), and thrombocytes (PLT)
cohort: 114 premature infants born at ≤ 32 weeks gestational age and with a birth weight ≤ 1710 g
finding: Positive bacterial cultures, particularly from the anus, throat, and blood, were significantly correlated with severe ROP requiring treatment.
